name: Data Dictionary and DSS Instance datasets test project
description:
[Link to download the Data Dictionary Agent DSS Plugin](https://github.com/THE-MOLECULAR-MAN/dss-plugin-data-dictionary-agent/releases/)

[Link to download the Datasets about Dataiku Instance DSS Plugin](https://github.com/THE-MOLECULAR-MAN/dss-plugin-xzibit/releases/)

The "Run Test" flow is a comprehensive data processing and synchronization system designed for a software development and deployment environment. It processes multiple input datasets, each representing different components of the system, such as plugins, connections, recipes, clusters, code environments, datasets, projects, users, and applications. These datasets contain crucial metadata and configuration details necessary for effective system management and operation.

The flow executes a series of synchronization steps to ensure that the data in each input dataset is current and consistent. This involves validating, cleaning, or updating the data to accurately reflect the system's present state. The result of this flow is a collection of "copy" datasets, which are updated versions of the input datasets. These include:

- **xzibit_connections_copy**: Updated connection configurations with current access control details.
- **xzibit_plugins_copy**: Updated plugin metadata, including development status and usage statistics.
- **xzibit_clusters_copy**: Updated information on Kubernetes clusters, including usage metrics and operational status.
- **xzibit_codeenvs_copy**: Updated details on Python code environments, ensuring proper configuration.
- **xzibit_projects_copy**: Updated information on software projects, including ownership and status.
- **xzibit_recipes_copy**: Updated metadata on project recipes, ensuring correct categorization.
- **xzibit_apps_copy**: Updated application metadata, including visibility and usage details.
- **xzibit_users_copy**: Updated user management details, ensuring correct access and permissions.
- **xzibit_datasets_copy**: Updated metadata and configurations for managing project data.

In summary, the "Run Test" flow ensures that all system components are synchronized and up-to-date, supporting efficient management and operation of the software development and deployment environment.
shortDesc:
This project is designed to test out the Data Dictionary Agent and Datasets about Dataiku Instance DSS Plugins, written by Tim Honker & Abi Edwards
